en-US.author: Apache Thrift Developers
en-US.longDescription:
Apache Thrift is a software framework for scalable cross-language services
development. It combines a software stack with a code generation engine to
build services that work efficiently between a large number of languages.

This package contains the Thrift compiler, which turns a .thrift interface
definition into client and server code. The runtime libraries are distributed
separately, through each language's own package manager.
en-US.name: Apache Thrift Compiler
